justification: Changes which rules the nightly council_quote --apply --unchecked sweep judges: unproven shown rules are re-judged once they are 7 days old. Measured 2026-10-29: 412 extra rules on the first night (10,977 vs 10,565 NULL already selected), ~115 a night after.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: UNCHECKED_SQL stops selecting unproven shown rules, or starts re-judging proven ones
falsifiable_check.observed_red: 2026-10-29: after #1528, #1533 and #1542 merged, 794 shown rules stayed unconfirmed (Penrith 27, unchanged) because --unchecked selected quote_status IS NULL only.

pre_impl.existing_data: 794 shown unconfirmed rules across 14 councils on 2026-10-29; last quote check 2026-10-28.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The sweep assumed a verdict never changes unless the PDF or text changes; checker fixes change it too.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Widens the existing --unchecked selection; no new flag, table or column.

functions.name: fetch
functions.input: council, ids, chapter and the unchecked flag from the command line
functions.output: rules to judge: never judged, or unproven, shown and older than RECHECK_DAYS
functions.if_none: an empty list judges nothing and writes nothing

values.if_missing: NULL quote_checked_at counts as due, so the rule is re-checked

queries.purpose: pick the rules the nightly sweep judges
queries.where_clause: id = ANY(%s) AND is_current AND (quote_status IS NULL OR (quote_status = 'unconfirmed' AND v2_is_actionable AND (quote_checked_at IS NULL OR quote_checked_at < now() - interval '7 days')))

break_it.scenario: Hundreds of picture-page rules re-run OCR every night.
break_it.what_happens: The nightly job runs far longer than before.
break_it.how: Each unproven rule returns once a week, so about a seventh of them run on any night.

break_it.scenario: A proven rule gets re-judged and loses its proof.
break_it.what_happens: Council words disappear from a page that showed them.
break_it.how: Only quote_status NULL or 'unconfirmed' are selected; the test asserts exact/recovered are not.

break_it.scenario: A rule hidden from visitors is re-judged every week.
break_it.what_happens: Nightly time is wasted on rules nobody sees.

post_merge.db_reset: No. Takes effect at the next nightly run.
post_merge.manual_verify: Yes: next morning, count shown unconfirmed rules with quote_checked_at older than 7 days; it should fall.
